Package org.geysermc.paletter.behaviour

Class BlockBehaviour

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.behaviour.BlockBehaviour
public final class BlockBehaviour extends Object
The behaviour keys of block states, read with palette.resolve(state).behaviour().get(key) (BlockValues). Values are per state and per data version; BlockValues.explain(org.geysermc.paletter.behaviour.BehaviourKey<?>) says where one comes from. Each key is a property of Bedrock Dedicated Server (its source is named on the key), in BDS's units, not those of add-on components: custom blocks are converted (the component minecraft:friction 0.4 is a friction of 0.6).
Since:
1.0.0
